stations.name: Smith Machine
stations.notes: High stability, fixed bar path. Great for beginners and consistent tension.

stations.name: Back Upper Pulley
stations.notes: Constant tension. Use for pulldowns, face pulls, pushdowns, crunches.

stations.name: Back Lower Pulley
stations.notes: Constant tension. Use for rows, curls, pull-throughs, wrist work.

attachments.name: Pair of single D-handles
attachments.why: Unlocks single-arm presses/rows/curls/raises; best for symmetry and shoulder comfort.

attachments.name: Triceps rope
attachments.why: Best for pushdowns, face pulls, overhead extensions.

attachments.name: Short straight bar (cable bar)
attachments.why: Curls, pushdowns, wrist curls, straight-arm pulldowns.

attachments.name: Ankle strap
attachments.why: Glute kickbacks, hip abduction/adduction, standing ham curls.

attachments.name: Ab strap (cable crunch strap)
attachments.why: More comfortable heavy cable crunches than holding a bar.

attachments.name: Lat bar
attachments.why: Wide/standard pulldown and straight-arm pulldown patterns.

attachments.name: EZ/angled lat bar
attachments.why: Comfort grip variations; good for underhand/angled pulldowns.

attachments.name: Dip belt or strong assistance band
attachments.why: If you want assisted pull-ups using the Smith bar setup.
